title: SPICY RIB EYE BEEF ROAST
ingredients: 1/3 - 1/2 cup coarse or cracked pepper (I used cracked)
directions: Trim excess fat, if any. Combine pepper & cardamom. Pat onto roast.
Gently pour over roast, cover & marinate overnight, turning occasionally.
Discard marinate & wrap in foil in shallow baking pan.
Insert meat thermometer, careful not to touch foil.
Bake 325, approx 2 1/2 - 2 3/4 hrs. Meat temp 150-160 degrees.
Let rest covered 15-30 minutes. (Optional per Dad!)
notes: I once used 7 lb roast for 10. Had some leftovers.
